purpose: Mark whether a claim belongs to core Christian confession, broad Christian agreement, contested doctrine, practical theology, analogy, or speculative research.

labels.meaning: Belongs to core Trinitarian and Christological confession shared by historic Nicene Christianity.
Widely affirmed across many Christian traditions, while details may differ.
Christian traditions disagree on formulation, scope, or application.
Safe for disciplined practice when bounded by Scripture, community, humility, and harm safeguards.
Illuminating comparison that must not be treated as proof.
Possible research direction that needs sources, counter-readings, and pressure tests before theological use.
